description: This header file defines comparison-related types and functions in the absl namespace, including classes for weak and strong equality and ordering, used for three-way comparisons. It provides C++11 compatible replacements for C++20 comparison types.

classes.name: weak_equality
classes.description: Represents the result of weak equality comparison, with possible values equivalent or nonequivalent.

classes.name: strong_equality
classes.description: Represents the result of strong equality comparison, with possible values equal, nonequal, and conversions to weak_equality.

classes.name: partial_ordering
classes.description: Represents three-way comparison results with less, equivalent, greater, and unordered states.

classes.name: weak_ordering
classes.description: Represents three-way comparison results with less, equivalent, greater, and conversions to weak_equality and partial_ordering.

classes.name: strong_ordering
classes.description: Represents three-way comparison results with less, equal, equivalent, greater, and conversions to other comparison types.
